subject: Alpha3 overflow recovery conflates semantic resync with Shizuku render readiness
body: CONFIRMED at 98a7c1c: Fold7HingeIngressBatch overflow is detected/bounded, but FoldOverlayService releases continuity then calls continuity.arm() only when ShizukuBridge.ready. release() does not reset Fold7ContinuityController; arm() does. Therefore after overflow with Shizuku unavailable, semantic state can remain stale even though a retained authoritative checkpoint exists, and that stale state is immediately used for folded-rest corroboration. A second determinism issue is that arm()/downstream recovery samples mutable hinge.lastAngle and drain-time uptime rather than drain.samples.last() + its observedUptimeMs. R&D Kotlin matrix reproduces two stale-state contradictions with privilege unavailable and no divergence when privilege is available. Proposed direction: unconditional loss-aware controller reset from the drain's retained final sample/source time; gate only render ownership on Shizuku. Do not replay the retained sample through normal onHinge because dropped history makes motion direction unknowable.
